scope: Corollary 21.2 (Outer area-minimizing boundary) of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 117. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Corollary 21.1, suppose that every filled enclosing cut of the whole boundary has area at least A = Areag(S). If A ≥ 4πQ2, then m ≥ s A 16π + Q2 r π A . In particular this applies to maximal purely electric source-free electrovacuum data with such a boundary and zero ADM momentum.
